purpose: Prove that the Guide can select, grab, reposition, and place a very small set of existing visible Core pieces inside the HC024B Core Work view without enabling chemistry, spawning new pieces, or opening a detached editor.
playerEvidence: HC024A external Core inspection works as a useful close view
HC024B Guide/Core Work third view works mechanically even though the entry button sequence is still prototype ergonomics
player wants the Guide to help manipulate accumulated Core anatomy rather than use a conventional crafting menu

entryFlow.worldToCoreInspection: Y controller / F keyboard / V alias
entryFlow.selectPiece: D-Pad Left/Right while not holding a piece
entryFlow.coreWorkToWorld: Y controller / F keyboard / V alias

allowedScope: reuse the four existing player_growth_connection_node objects as the prototype piece set
persist placement offsets on those existing objects during the runtime session
reuse A/E contextually as grab/place once Core Work is active
reuse D-Pad Left/Right to select a visible piece inside Core Work
reuse Left Stick as piece movement while Core Work temporarily suppresses world traversal
reuse RT/LT as outward/inward piece depth while Core Work suppresses world absorb/stabilize
reuse Right Stick as camera orbit
move the existing Guide pose toward the currently selected piece
reuse the existing Guide shimmer line to connect Guide and selected piece
update compact HUD and debug state
acceptanceTests: HC024A World/Core inspection toggle remains intact
HC024B A/E Core Work entry remains intact
visible binding nodes become a selectable four-piece prototype set
D-Pad Left/Right changes the selected visible node
A grabs the selected node and A again places it
Left Stick moves the held node relative to the current camera composition
RT moves the held node outward and LT moves it inward within a bounded radius
Right Stick continues to orbit the camera while a node is held
Guide visibly attends the selected/held node
piece placement remains visible after leaving Core Work
no chemistry, stat, progression, geography, or new-geometry effect occurs
nextIfPasses: HC024C1 should first lock selection/depth readability if live play finds manipulation too subtle; only after that may HC024D attach at most two temporary chemistry reactions.
